_about: THE NEW ACT-ONE ENEMIES (FACTIONS 11/3, VAMILY rule 302, Paolo 11/2: 'more content... new enemies, new graphics, the whole package'; laws/BOHEMIA_LAW_THE_BEASTS_ARE_LAB_MADE_AND_THE_BESTIARY_FLOOR_9_29_26.md: at least 12 factions and ~75 enemy types, every Battle Brothers archetype keeps its lesson in a Bohemia skin, act one feels medieval). ONE FILE A MODDER CAN EDIT: every row is a whole enemy type (its name on the board, its Battle Brothers lesson, the wiki row it rides on, its stats, its gear, its brain, its look), every brain is a list of behaviours the fight already reads or one of the eight new ones below, every faction is a make-up by phase, and the road table says where and when each faction walks. The fight folds this file into its own tables when it deals a board (slices/BOHEMIA_FIGHT.html ownEnemies); nothing here is typed twice. Stats are the wiki row's own numbers unless a row's 'stats' says otherwise, and every such change carries its why. Every word is draft:true (WORDS owns them); every felt number is TUNING's to move (tuned:false).
source: records/target/bb/enemies.json (each row's 'from' is a wiki unit row, its page cited there); reference/library/grok/wiki/PAGES_ALL.tar.gz for each behaviour's page

house.name: The House
house.lesson: A formation. Shields in front, hooks behind them, crossbows behind that. Break the wall or go round it.

watch.name: The Block Watch
watch.lesson: Neighbors with pitchforks. Hurt one and he runs. Their captain calls them back, so drop him first.

keepers.name: The Keepers
keepers.lesson: Desert people. They throw an axe as you close, and one of them never stops.

water.name: The Water People
water.lesson: You do not see them until they are on you. Their needles slow you down for three turns.

rows.name: House Shield
rows.lesson_bb: THE SHIELD WALL (Battle Brothers' Footman: 'Shieldwall' on every shield, bb_all/1780_Shieldwall (20 fatigue).txt)
rows.lesson: He locks his shield with the men beside him. Each one in the wall makes the others harder to hit. Hit the end of the line, or make him swing.

stats.why: act one (the perks: the shield, nothing else; the wiki's footman carries every mastery, Battle Forged and Brawny): the wiki's footman is a mid-game soldier (70 skill, a kite shield, mail to 230); the House's first men are recruits with a car door for a shield (the wiki's wooden shield) and what a 2050 shop sells, so a conscript's skill and the low end of the armour. Measured: as the wiki's footman, two of them beat a new crew of three 13 times in 20

rows.name: House Hook
rows.lesson_bb: THE POLEARM BEHIND THE WALL (Battle Brothers' Billman: 'Hook', bb_all/1021_Hook (25 fatigue).txt: the target is pulled closer)
rows.lesson: He stands one step behind the shields and reaches over them. His hook drags your man off his line and into the wall.

stats.why: act one: the low half of the wiki's range

rows.name: House Crossbow
rows.lesson_bb: THE ARCHER LINE (Battle Brothers' Arbalester: shoot, reload, shoot, from behind the line)
rows.lesson: They stay back and all shoot the same man. Close the gap fast, or put cover between you.

rows.name: Neighbor
rows.lesson_bb: THE COWARD WHO RUNS (Battle Brothers' Armed Peasant: low resolve, the first to flee)
rows.lesson: A scared man with a pitchfork. Cut him once, hard, and he runs for home.

rows.name: Block Captain
rows.lesson_bb: THE LEADER WHO RALLIES (Battle Brothers' Militia Captain: 'Rally the Troops', bb_all/1634_Rally the Troops.txt; 'Captain', bb_all/0343_Captain.txt)
rows.lesson: He stays behind his neighbors and yells them back into the fight. Kill him and the ones who run keep running.

stats.why: act one: the low half of the wiki's range

rows.name: Feral
rows.lesson_bb: THE BERSERKER (Battle Brothers' Orc Berserker: 'Berserk', bb_all/0232_Berserk.txt: 4 AP back on a kill, once a turn)
rows.lesson: He runs straight at your weakest man and never breaks. Every kill gives him another swing. Stop him before he reaches your back line.

stats.why: a man, not an orc: the wiki's 250 hitpoints is the orc's body; ours is a big man on something, so a sergeant's hitpoints (the wiki's 100, plus a tenth), skins and furs for armour, and nothing scares him (he never wavers: that is the lesson)

rows.name: Keeper
rows.lesson_bb: THE SKIRMISHER WHO THROWS FIRST (Battle Brothers' Barbarian Thrall: throwing axes, then the cleaver)
rows.lesson: He throws an axe as you walk in, then pulls a cleaver. Do not stand in the open on the way to him.

rows.name: Cutter
rows.lesson_bb: THE AMBUSHER (Battle Brothers' nomads and goblin ambushers: they wait where you cannot see them)
rows.lesson: You cannot see him until he is two steps away or he hits you. Keep your men together.

rows.name: Needle
rows.lesson_bb: THE ONE WHO POISONS (Battle Brothers' Goblin Ambusher: 'Goblin Poison', bb_all/1576_Poisoned (Goblin) (Status Effect).txt: -1 AP, -10 initiative, -1 vision, 3 turns)
rows.lesson: The darts carry lab sedative. A hit takes a step off your man, slows him and blurs his eyes for three turns. Kill the needle before your best fighter gets tagged.

stats.why: a grown woman, not a goblin: the wiki's 40 hitpoints plus a quarter

shieldwall.quote: Doubles Melee Defense and Ranged Defense shield stats for 1 turn (including the Shield Expert perk bonus). Grants additional +5 Melee Defense and +5 Ranged Defense for each adjacent ally using the Shieldwall

hooker.quote: +10% chance to hit, target is pulled closer to user

volley.quote: the backline of the Noble House line; FACTIONS: they all shoot the man the first bolt hit

coward.quote: the wiki's 35 resolve; FACTIONS: under half his hitpoints he runs, once

rallier.quote: Rally the Troops; FACTIONS: he calls a man back the moment he wavers, not only when he breaks

berserker.quote: Once per turn, upon killing an enemy, 4 Action Points are immediately regained

thrower.quote: the thrall's bundle of throwing axes, then the cleaver

ambusher.quote: FACTIONS: unseen until a man of yours stands within lurk.seen_within tiles or he strikes

shieldwall.quote: 4 AP, 20 fatigue; doubles the shield's defences for a turn; +5 for each adjacent ally using it. near_tiles is ours: he raises it when a foe is that close

hook.quote: 6 AP, 25 fatigue, +10% chance to hit, target is pulled closer to user; target_fatigue is ours (the page's number is cut off in the library)

lurk.quote: he shows when a man of yours is two tiles away, or the moment he strikes

road.why: Paolo: 'Battle Brothers... how many groups are moving around at a certain time... way more'; enemies are never forced (a party you can see and avoid). A roaming party takes its faction from the act (by_act, added to COMBAT's road_factions), from the ground it walks (the faction that holds that ground in records/target/bb/factions.json walks there district_mult times as often) and from the hour (night).
road.night_why: the block watch goes home after dark; the water people and the keepers move at night (draft)
